edition.title: This weekend on Keowee + Jocassee
edition.dek: Walhalla Performing Arts Center stacks two heavy hitters back to back — Sammy Kershaw Friday, Sam Bush Saturday — while Jocassee Valley Brewing runs music and food trucks all three nights, opening Friday with a brook trout fireside chat before the band.

events.title: Sammy Kershaw at Walhalla Performing Arts Center
events.body: The "Cadillac Style" honky-tonk veteran headlines WPAC's stage for one night only.
events.note: $79–$99 · 7:30pm · Walhalla Performing Arts Center, 101 E. North Broad St., Walhalla

events.title: Brook trout fireside chat, then Isaiah Breedlove at Jocassee Valley Brewing
events.body: Friends of Jocassee and SCDNR's Hailey Goyette talk Southern Appalachian brook trout restoration before the music starts; Majoes Filipino's truck is out front for dinner.
events.note: Free · Fireside chat 5:30pm, music 6:30pm · open 9am–9pm · Jocassee Valley Brewing, Salem
events.source: Friends of Jocassee · Jocassee Valley Brewing

events.title: Free live music Friday and Saturday at Keowee Brewing
events.body: Keowee Brewing runs live music both nights like clockwork — the brewery doesn't post who's playing until close to showtime, so check their calendar or Facebook day-of.
events.note: Free · 6:30–8:30pm Fri & Sat · Keowee Brewing, 401 E. Main St., Seneca

events.title: Sam Bush: Father of Newgrass at Walhalla Performing Arts Center
events.body: The mandolin player who helped name the genre brings his band back through the Upstate.
events.note: $54–$74 · 7:30pm · Walhalla Performing Arts Center, 101 E. North Broad St., Walhalla

events.title: Oyster roast and gumbo, then Doug Hendrix at Jocassee Valley Brewing
events.body: OPUS Trust's oyster roast and gumbo lands midafternoon, with Doug Hendrix playing in the evening.
events.note: Free to attend · Food 4pm, music 6:30pm · open 9am–9pm · Jocassee Valley Brewing, Salem

events.title: Goers & Allen close out the weekend at Jocassee Valley Brewing
events.body: An afternoon set to end things, with Farm to Fire Fermentery's wood-fired pizza truck out front.
events.note: Free · Music at 4pm · open 12–7pm · Jocassee Valley Brewing, Salem

plan.title: Eat in Walhalla before Sammy Kershaw
plan.body: WPAC doors run prompt for a 7:30 start, so grab dinner first rather than rushing in.
plan.label: Find a spot to eat & drink →

plan.title: Get on the water before the oyster roast
plan.body: Launch early on Keowee or Jocassee while the lake is quiet, then head to Jocassee Valley Brewing for the 4pm oyster roast and gumbo.
plan.label: Find a ramp →

plan.title: Check the lake level before the Sunday set
plan.body: Music at Jocassee Valley Brewing starts at 4pm — see where Keowee and Jocassee stand before you head out for the afternoon.
plan.label: Check the lake level →
